title: Wire confident capture -> auto-add to basket
description: On confident capture: auto-close camera, add item at qty 1 via domain add(), beep/haptic feedback. The core one-tap scan-to-basket flow. See docs/architecture/overview.md.
acceptance_criteria: Tap Scan next item, point at a label, and a correctly-named/priced item appears in the basket at qty 1 with feedback, camera closed.

title: Price + name extraction into Capture
description: From recognised text: pick the largest numeric value as price (bounding-box area as signal), parse both '79p' (pence) and '£2.49' (pounds) to integer pence; take prominent non-price lines as name; compute isConfident from OCR confidence + plausible price + steadiness. See docs/architecture/scanner.md.
acceptance_criteria: A real/sample Aldi label yields the correct name and price in pence; pence and pound labels both parse correctly.

title: Scanner seam + VisionKit camera screen
description: Define the Scanner protocol (scanNextItem() -> ScanResult with Capture{name, priceInPence, isConfident}). Camera screen using VisionKit DataScannerViewController that recognises live text. UI never sees Vision types. See docs/architecture/scanner.md.
acceptance_criteria: Tapping Scan next item opens the camera and the app receives recognised text tokens from a shelf label.

title: SwiftData persistence of the current trip
description: Persist exactly one current trip via SwiftData; save on every mutation; New trip replaces it. No long-term history. See docs/architecture/basket-domain.md.
acceptance_criteria: Closing/backgrounding and reopening the app restores the same basket and budget.

title: Home screen: budget, total, remaining, basket list
description: SwiftUI home screen: big remaining figure (red/over when isOverBudget), running total, editable budget, scrollable basket list with +/- steppers, line totals, delete, New trip (with confirm), empty state. Manual add for now. See docs/architecture/ui.md.
acceptance_criteria: User can set a budget, hand-add items, adjust quantities, delete rows, and see remaining update and go red when over budget.

title: Basket/Trip domain model + operations
description: Trip and BasketItem models with all money in integer pence. Operations: add, edit, setQuantity (floors at 1), remove, setBudget, startNewTrip. Computed total/remaining/isOverBudget. No UI/camera. See docs/architecture/basket-domain.md.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover add/edit/qty/remove/budget and total/remaining/over-budget math in pence.

title: SwiftUI iOS 17 project scaffold + app entry
description: Create the Xcode SwiftUI app project targeting iOS 17+. App entry point, base navigation. See docs/architecture/overview.md.
acceptance_criteria: App builds in Xcode and launches on an iPhone (iOS 17+) showing a placeholder home screen.

title: Milestone 2 — One-tap OCR scanning
description: Add VisionKit camera + label OCR on top of the basket. Demoable: tap Scan next item, point at an Aldi label, confident read auto-adds item (qty 1).

title: Milestone 1 — Runnable basket skeleton (no camera)
description: End-to-end working basket with manual entry: project scaffold, domain model, home screen, persistence. Demoable: hand-add items and watch remaining vs budget, survives app close.

title: Aldi Budget Scanner — iOS app
description: Native SwiftUI iOS 17+ app for a single user shopping in Aldi. Scans shelf-label prices via on-device OCR (no barcode), keeps an itemised basket (name, price, qty) with a running total against a per-trip budget. Fully offline, current trip persisted via SwiftData. See docs/architecture/overview.md.

title: Interactive HTML UI mockup on GitHub Pages
description: Throwaway HTML mockup of the iOS screens (home/basket, scan camera, confirm card) styled like iPhone, hosted on GitHub Pages and linked from README, so the end user can preview the UX before SwiftUI is built. Not the real app.
acceptance_criteria: A live GitHub Pages URL shows the three mocked screens; README links to it.
close_reason: HTML mockup live on GitHub Pages and linked from README

title: Full row editor + empty states polish
description: Row editor to correct name/price/quantity and delete any basket row after the fact; polished empty/first-run states. See docs/architecture/ui.md.
acceptance_criteria: Any basket row can be fully edited or deleted; empty basket shows helpful prompts.

title: Duplicate suppression for rapid re-scans
description: Remember the last captured label (text/price) for a few seconds; ignore matching re-reads so lingering/walking past doesn't double-add. See docs/architecture/scanner.md.
acceptance_criteria: Holding the camera on one label, or re-reading it within a few seconds, adds the item only once.

title: Low-confidence/failure handling + confirm card
description: On low-confidence capture or failure: alert the user and show a pre-filled editable confirm card (name + price). Add commits, Cancel discards. Only appears when unsure. See docs/architecture/ui.md.
acceptance_criteria: An uncertain/failed read never auto-adds; the user gets an editable pre-filled card and can correct then add.

title: Milestone 3 — Robustness & correction
description: Make scanning trustworthy in a real shop: confirm card for low-confidence reads, duplicate suppression, full row editing/empty states.
